newsitem.title: USA: Dow holds modest gains as late session rally fades.
newsitem.headline: Dow holds modest gains as late session rally fades.

text.p: Wall Street stocks backed off their session highs in late afternoon trading on Wednesday, as investors largely shrugged off the outcome of the Federal Reserve meeting and focused on Thursday's employment report.
The Dow was up 30 points at 7752 after briefly rallying as high as 7765. The Nasdaq composite was up 10 to 1448.

"I'd be really surprised if there was a meaningful percentage movement between now and the end of the day," said Douglas Cliggott, U.S. equity strategist at J.P. Morgan. "(The Fed's) leaving things (interest rates) unchanged was pretty much already in the market."
